`tests/test_ios_frida_toolchain.py`:

```py
"""Run the generated musl compiler wrappers against discovered executable tools."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRIPT = ROOT / "tools/ios/build-frida-musl-devkit.sh"
LLVM_TOOLS = ("llvm-ar", "llvm-nm", "llvm-ranlib", "llvm-strip", "llvm-readelf", "llvm-objcopy", "llvm-objdump")
TOOL_VARIABLES = ("AR", "LD", "NM", "RANLIB", "STRIP", "READELF", "OBJCOPY", "OBJDUMP")

# Verbatim reader from Frida 16.0.7 releng/setup-env.sh. Keep this legacy
# consumer independent of the wrappers, without requiring a downloaded build tree.
FRIDA_TOOLCHAIN_READER = r"""
read_toolchain_variable ()
{
  local result_var_name=$1
  local env_var_name=$2
  local fallback_value=$3

  if [ $host_machine == $build_machine ] && [ "$FRIDA_CROSS" == yes ]; then
    local contextual_env_var_name=${env_var_name}_FOR_BUILD
  else
    local contextual_env_var_name=${env_var_name}
  fi

  eval "$result_var_name=(${!contextual_env_var_name:-$fallback_value})"
}
"""


class FridaMuslToolchainTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.bin = self.root / "bin"
        self.bin.mkdir()
        self.prefix = self.root / "tool chain $(touch UNEXPECTED_EXECUTION)"
        self.source = self.root / "frida source"
        self.prefixes = {name: self.prefix / name for name in ("llvm", "lld", "zig")}
        for prefix in self.prefixes.values():
            (prefix / "bin").mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in LLVM_TOOLS:
            self.fake_tool(self.prefixes["llvm"] / "bin" / name)
        self.fake_tool(self.prefixes["lld"] / "bin/ld.lld")
        self.fake_tool(self.prefixes["zig"] / "bin/zig")
        self.executable(self.bin / "brew", "import sys\nprefixes = " + repr({key: str(value) for key, value in self.prefixes.items()}) + "\nif len(sys.argv) != 3 or sys.argv[1] != '--prefix' or sys.argv[2] not in prefixes:\n    raise SystemExit(1)\nprint(prefixes[sys.argv[2]])\n")
        self.environment = dict(os.environ)
        for name in (*TOOL_VARIABLES, "ZIG", "BASH_ENV", "ENV"):
            self.environment.pop(name, None)
        self.environment.update(PATH=str(self.bin) + os.pathsep + os.defpath, MIRA_IOS_FRIDA_SOURCE_DIR=str(self.source), FRIDA_VERSION="16.0.7")

    def executable(self, path, body):
        path.write_text(f"#!{sys.executable}\n" + body)
        path.chmod(0o755)

    def fake_tool(self, path):
        self.executable(path, "import json, sys\nprint(json.dumps({'tool': " + repr(path.name) + ", 'args': sys.argv[1:]}))\n")

    def prepare(self, extra="", check=True):
        return subprocess.run(["bash", "-c", 'source "$1"\nprepare_macos_musl_wrapper\n' + extra, "test", str(SCRIPT)], cwd=self.root, env=self.environment, capture_output=True, text=True, check=check)

    def wrapper(self, compiler, *args):
        path = self.source / "build/musl-wrap" / compiler
        result = subprocess.run([str(path), *args], cwd=self.root, env=self.environment, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        return json.loads(result.stdout)

    def prepare_real_zig(self):
        zig = shutil.which("zig")
        if zig is None:
            self.skipTest("Zig is required for the real compiler smoke test")
        selected = self.prefixes["zig"] / "bin/zig"
        selected.unlink()
        selected.symlink_to(Path(zig).resolve())
        self.environment["ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR"] = str(self.root / "zig-cache")
        self.prepare()

    def run_real_compiler(self, compiler, *args):
        result = subprocess.run([str(self.source / "build/musl-wrap" / compiler), *map(str, args)], cwd=self.root, env=self.environment, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)

    def test_unversioned_homebrew_tools_and_wrapper_version_probes(self):
        self.prepare()
        for compiler, language in (("i686-linux-musl-gcc", "cc"), ("i686-linux-musl-g++", "c++")):
            with self.subTest(compiler=compiler):
                self.assertEqual(self.wrapper(compiler, "-Wl,--version"), {"tool": "ld.lld", "args": ["--version"]})
                self.assertEqual(self.wrapper(compiler, "--version"), {"tool": "zig", "args": [language, "-target", "x86-linux-musl", "--version"]})
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "UNEXPECTED_EXECUTION").exists())

    def test_compiler_target_and_existing_argument_handling_are_preserved(self):
        self.prepare()
        for compiler, language in (("i686-linux-musl-gcc", "cc"), ("i686-linux-musl-g++", "c++")):
            with self.subTest(compiler=compiler):
                normal = self.wrapper(compiler, "-m32", "-march=pentium4", "hello source.c", "-o", "output.o")
                self.assertEqual(normal["args"], [language, "-target", "x86-linux-musl", "hello source.c", "-o", "output.o", "-Wno-error=incompatible-function-pointer-types", "-Wno-int-conversion"])
                macros = self.wrapper(compiler, "-E", "-dM", "input.h")
                self.assertEqual(macros["args"][:3], [language, "-target", "i386-linux-musl"])

    def test_preprocessing_takes_precedence_over_compile_and_assembly_modes(self):
        self.prepare()
        for compiler in ("i686-linux-musl-gcc", "i686-linux-musl-g++"):
            for modes in (("-E", "-c"), ("-c", "-E"), ("-E", "-S"), ("-S", "-E", "-c")):
                with self.subTest(compiler=compiler, modes=modes):
                    args = self.wrapper(compiler, *modes, "-P", "-x", "assembler-with-cpp", "libffi.map.in", "-o", "libffi.map")["args"]
                    self.assertIn("-E", args)
                    self.assertNotIn("-c", args)
                    self.assertNotIn("-S", args)
                    self.assertEqual(args[4:-2], ["-P", "-x", "assembler-with-cpp", "libffi.map.in", "-o", "libffi.map"])
            for mode in ("-c", "-S"):
                with self.subTest(compiler=compiler, mode=mode):
                    args = self.wrapper(compiler, mode, "input.c", "-o", "output")["args"]
                    self.assertEqual(args[3:-2], [mode, "input.c", "-o", "output"])

    def test_real_zig_preprocesses_libffi_version_script(self):
        self.prepare_real_zig()
        source = self.root / "libffi.map.in"
        source.write_text("#define ABI LIBFFI_BASE_8.0\nABI {\n  global:\n    ffi_call;\n  local:\n    *;\n};\n")
        for compiler in ("i686-linux-musl-gcc", "i686-linux-musl-g++"):
            for mode in ("-c", "-S"):
                with self.subTest(compiler=compiler, mode=mode):
                    output = self.root / (compiler + mode + ".map")
                    dependencies = output.with_suffix(".d")
                    self.run_real_compiler(compiler, "-m32", "-march=pentium4", "-E", "-P", "-x", "assembler-with-cpp", "-DGENERATE_LIBFFI_MAP", "-MD", "-MQ", output, "-MF", dependencies, "-o", output, mode, source)
                    self.assertEqual(" ".join(output.read_text().split()), "LIBFFI_BASE_8.0 { global: ffi_call; local: *; };")
                    self.assertIn(source.name, dependencies.read_text())

    def test_real_zig_still_compiles_objects_and_emits_assembly(self):
        self.prepare_real_zig()
        for compiler, extension in (("i686-linux-musl-gcc", "c"), ("i686-linux-musl-g++", "cpp")):
            source = self.root / ("answer." + extension)
            source.write_text("int answer(void) { return 42; }\n")
            with self.subTest(compiler=compiler):
                obj = source.with_name(source.name + ".o")
                self.run_real_compiler(compiler, "-c", source, "-o", obj)
                self.assertEqual(obj.read_bytes()[:5], b"\x7fELF\x01")
                assembly = source.with_name(source.name + ".s")
                self.run_real_compiler(compiler, "-S", source, "-o", assembly)
                self.assertIn("answer", assembly.read_text())

    def test_every_exported_llvm_tool_is_executable(self):
        result = self.prepare('for name in AR LD NM RANLIB STRIP READELF OBJCOPY OBJDUMP; do "${!name}" --version; done')
        actual = [json.loads(line)["tool"] for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
        self.assertEqual(actual, ["llvm-ar", "ld.lld", "llvm-nm", "llvm-ranlib", "llvm-strip", "llvm-readelf", "llvm-objcopy", "llvm-objdump"])

    def test_explicit_linker_wins_and_invalid_override_fails_early(self):
        linker = self.root / "custom ld.lld"
        self.fake_tool(linker)
        self.environment["LD"] = str(linker)
        self.prepare()
        self.assertEqual(self.wrapper("i686-linux-musl-gcc", "-Wl,--version")["tool"], "custom ld.lld")
        self.environment["LD"] = str(self.root / "missing")
        result = self.prepare(check=False)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("Configured tool for ld.lld is not executable", result.stderr)

    def test_explicit_zig_override_wins_and_preserves_literal_path(self):
        zig = self.root / "pinned zig $(touch ZIG_OVERRIDE_EXECUTION)"
        self.fake_tool(zig)
        self.environment["ZIG"] = str(zig)
        self.prepare()
        for compiler, language in (("i686-linux-musl-gcc", "cc"), ("i686-linux-musl-g++", "c++")):
            with self.subTest(compiler=compiler):
                version = self.wrapper(compiler, "--version")
                self.assertEqual(version, {"tool": zig.name, "args": [language, "-target", "x86-linux-musl", "--version"]})
                compilation = self.wrapper(compiler, "-c", "input.c", "-o", "output.o")
                self.assertEqual(compilation["tool"], zig.name)
                self.assertEqual(compilation["args"][3:7], ["-c", "input.c", "-o", "output.o"])
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "ZIG_OVERRIDE_EXECUTION").exists())

    def test_invalid_zig_override_fails_before_generating_wrappers(self):
        self.environment["ZIG"] = str(self.root / "missing zig")
        result = self.prepare(check=False)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("Configured tool for zig is not executable", result.stderr)
        self.assertFalse((self.source / "build/musl-wrap").exists())

    def test_upstream_cross_environment_consumes_selected_tools_without_evaluation(self):
        linker = self.prefix / "explicit linker $(touch OVERRIDE_EXECUTION)"
        self.fake_tool(linker)
        self.environment["LD"] = str(linker)
        releng = self.source / "releng"
        releng.mkdir(parents=True)
        setup = releng / "setup-env.sh"
        setup.write_text("#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -euo pipefail\n" + FRIDA_TOOLCHAIN_READER + r"""
host_machine=linux-x86
build_machine=macos-arm64
for name in CC CXX AR LD NM RANLIB STRIP READELF OBJCOPY OBJDUMP; do
  read_toolchain_variable selected "$name" unused
  if [[ "$name" == CC || "$name" == CXX ]]; then
    # The production Linux branch evaluates compiler commands a second time.
    eval selected=($selected)
  fi
  "${selected[@]}" --version
done
""")
        setup.chmod(0o755)
        result = self.prepare("prepare_linux_cross_env")
        actual = [json.loads(line)["tool"] for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
        self.assertEqual(actual, ["zig", "zig", "llvm-ar", linker.name, "llvm-nm", "llvm-ranlib", "llvm-strip", "llvm-readelf", "llvm-objcopy", "llvm-objdump"])
        for directory in (self.root, self.source):
            self.assertFalse((directory / "UNEXPECTED_EXECUTION").exists())
            self.assertFalse((directory / "OVERRIDE_EXECUTION").exists())

    def test_missing_homebrew_tool_falls_back_to_path(self):
        (self.prefixes["lld"] / "bin/ld.lld").unlink()
        self.fake_tool(self.bin / "ld.lld")
        self.prepare()
        self.assertEqual(self.wrapper("i686-linux-musl-gcc", "-Wl,--version")["tool"], "ld.lld")

    def test_missing_linker_stops_before_generating_wrappers(self):
        (self.prefixes["lld"] / "bin/ld.lld").unlink()
        result = self.prepare(check=False)
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("Unable to find executable ld.lld", result.stderr)
        self.assertFalse((self.source / "build/musl-wrap").exists())

    def test_known_versioned_homebrew_installations_remain_supported(self):
        self.executable(self.bin / "brew", "import sys\nprefixes = " + repr({key if key == "zig" else key + "@21": str(value) for key, value in self.prefixes.items()}) + "\nif len(sys.argv) != 3 or sys.argv[1] != '--prefix' or sys.argv[2] not in prefixes:\n    raise SystemExit(1)\nprint(prefixes[sys.argv[2]])\n")
        result = self.prepare('for name in AR LD NM RANLIB STRIP READELF OBJCOPY OBJDUMP; do "${!name}" --version; done')
        self.assertEqual(len(result.stdout.splitlines()), len(TOOL_VARIABLES))
        self.assertEqual(self.wrapper("i686-linux-musl-gcc", "-Wl,--version"), {"tool": "ld.lld", "args": ["--version"]})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ios_frida_unwind.py`:

```py
"""Exercise Frida's pinned x86 resume function without executing sigreturn."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRIPT = ROOT / "tools/ios/build-frida-musl-devkit.sh"

# Verbatim x86_local_resume from Frida libunwind
# ccd3a38597a8397a3382e4e58fdabb26a6f0be13, src/x86/Gos-linux.c.
# Kept here so clean checkouts need neither downloaded dependencies nor network.
UPSTREAM_RESUME = r'''HIDDEN int
x86_local_resume (unw_addr_space_t as, unw_cursor_t *cursor, void *arg)
{
  struct cursor *c = (struct cursor *) cursor;
  ucontext_t *uc = c->uc;

  /* Ensure c->pi is up-to-date.  On x86, it's relatively common to be
     missing DWARF unwind info.  We don't want to fail in that case,
     because the frame-chain still would let us do a backtrace at
     least.  */
  dwarf_make_proc_info (&c->dwarf);

  if (unlikely (c->sigcontext_format != X86_SCF_NONE))
    {
      struct sigcontext *sc = (struct sigcontext *) c->sigcontext_addr;

      Debug (8, "resuming at ip=%x via sigreturn(%p)\n", c->dwarf.ip, sc);
#if !defined(__ANDROID__)
      x86_sigreturn (sc);
#endif
    }
  else
    {
      Debug (8, "resuming at ip=%x via setcontext()\n", c->dwarf.ip);
#if !defined(__ANDROID__)
      setcontext (uc);
#endif
    }
  return -UNW_EINVAL;
}
'''

# The patch validates the callee's real signature and cursor interpretation.
SIGRETURN_PREFIX = '''HIDDEN void
x86_sigreturn (unw_cursor_t *cursor)
{
  struct cursor *c = (struct cursor *) cursor;
  struct sigcontext *sc = (struct sigcontext *) c->sigcontext_addr;
'''
UPSTREAM_SOURCE = UPSTREAM_RESUME + '\n' + SIGRETURN_PREFIX + '}\n'

HARNESS = r'''
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#define HIDDEN
#define unlikely(value) (value)
#define Debug(...) ((void) 0)
#define X86_SCF_NONE 0
#define UNW_EINVAL 22
typedef void *unw_addr_space_t;
typedef struct { unsigned marker; } ucontext_t;
struct sigcontext { unsigned marker; };
struct dwarf_cursor { unsigned ip; };
struct cursor {
  struct dwarf_cursor dwarf;
  ucontext_t *uc;
  int sigcontext_format;
  uintptr_t sigcontext_addr;
};
typedef struct cursor unw_cursor_t;
static struct cursor *expected;
static unsigned prepared, signals, contexts, wrong_pointer;
static void dwarf_make_proc_info(struct dwarf_cursor *dwarf) {
  prepared += dwarf == &expected->dwarf;
}
/* Accept either pointer type to observe the original bug without executing it. */
static void x86_sigreturn(void *argument) {
  ++signals;
  if (argument != expected) { ++wrong_pointer; return; }
  struct cursor *cursor = argument;
  if (cursor->uc->marker != 42 ||
      ((struct sigcontext *) cursor->sigcontext_addr)->marker != 77)
    ++wrong_pointer;
}
static void setcontext(ucontext_t *context) {
  ++contexts;
  if (context != expected->uc) ++wrong_pointer;
}
@RESUME@
int main(void) {
  ucontext_t context = {42};
  struct sigcontext frame = {77};
  struct cursor cursor = {{123}, &context, 1, (uintptr_t) &frame};
  expected = &cursor;
  int result = x86_local_resume(NULL, &cursor, NULL);
  if (result != -UNW_EINVAL || prepared != 1 || signals != 1 ||
      contexts != 0 || wrong_pointer != 0) {
    puts("FAIL: signal resume did not receive the complete cursor");
    return 1;
  }
  cursor.sigcontext_format = X86_SCF_NONE;
  result = x86_local_resume(NULL, &cursor, NULL);
  if (result != -UNW_EINVAL || prepared != 2 || signals != 1 ||
      contexts != 1 || wrong_pointer != 0) return 2;
  puts("PASS: signal cursor and ordinary ucontext paths");
  return 0;
}
'''


class FridaUnwindTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="mira-frida-unwind-")
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.source = self.root / "frida source"
        self.path = self.source / "deps/libunwind/src/x86/Gos-linux.c"
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.path.write_text(UPSTREAM_SOURCE)
        self.environment = dict(os.environ)
        for name in ("BASH_ENV", "ENV"):
            self.environment.pop(name, None)
        self.environment["MIRA_IOS_FRIDA_SOURCE_DIR"] = str(self.source)

    def patch(self, check=True):
        return subprocess.run(["bash", "-c", 'source "$1"\npatch_libunwind_x86_sigreturn', "test", str(SCRIPT)], cwd=self.root,
            env=self.environment, capture_output=True, text=True, check=check)

    def run_resume(self, source):
        compiler = shutil.which("cc")
        if compiler is None:
            self.skipTest("A host C compiler is required for the resume behavior test")
        # Extract the production function after applying the real source patch.
        start = source.index("HIDDEN int\nx86_local_resume (")
        end = source.index("\nHIDDEN void", start)
        program = self.root / "resume.c"
        executable = self.root / "resume"
        program.write_text(HARNESS.replace("@RESUME@", source[start:end]))
        subprocess.run([compiler, "-std=c99", str(program), "-o", str(executable)],
            check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        return subprocess.run([str(executable)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)

    def test_signal_resume_receives_complete_cursor_and_normal_resume_is_preserved(self):
        old = self.run_resume(self.path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(old.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("did not receive the complete cursor", old.stdout)
        self.patch()
        fixed = self.run_resume(self.path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(fixed.returncode, 0, fixed.stdout + fixed.stderr)
        self.assertIn("signal cursor and ordinary ucontext paths", fixed.stdout)

    def test_patch_is_idempotent_and_changes_only_the_argument(self):
        self.patch()
        expected = UPSTREAM_SOURCE.replace("x86_sigreturn (sc);", "x86_sigreturn (cursor);")
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_text(), expected)
        timestamp = self.path.stat().st_mtime_ns
        self.patch()
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_text(), expected)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.stat().st_mtime_ns, timestamp)

    def test_unexpected_source_is_rejected_without_overwrite(self):
        for contents in (
            UPSTREAM_SOURCE.replace("x86_sigreturn (sc);", "x86_sigreturn (other);"),
            UPSTREAM_SOURCE.replace("x86_sigreturn (unw_cursor_t *cursor)", "x86_sigreturn (void *cursor)"),
            UPSTREAM_SOURCE + "      x86_sigreturn (sc);\n",
        ):
            with self.subTest(contents=contents[-45:]):
                self.path.write_text(contents)
                result = self.patch(check=False)
                self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
                self.assertIn("unexpected libunwind x86 sigreturn", result.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(self.path.read_text(), contents)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
"""Check complete, platform-independent iOS Python dependencies without building iSH."""
import importlib.util
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
import zipfile


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ios_frida_runtime", ROOT / "tools/ios/prepare-ish-frida-runtime.py")
runtime = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = runtime
spec.loader.exec_module(runtime)


class FridaWheelTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.cache = self.root / "cache"
        self.cache.mkdir()
        self.available = self.root / "available"
        self.available.mkdir()

    def wheel(self, name, version="1.0", pure="true", tag="py3-none-any"):
        path = self.available / f"{name}-{version}-{tag}.whl"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as archive:
            archive.writestr(f"{name}/__init__.py", f"VERSION = {version!r}\n")
            archive.writestr(f"{name}-{version}.dist-info/WHEEL", f"Wheel-Version: 1.0\nRoot-Is-Purelib: {pure}\nTag: {tag}\n")
            archive.writestr(f"{name}-{version}.dist-info/METADATA", f"Metadata-Version: 2.1\nName: {name}\nVersion: {version}\n")
        return path

    def pip_result(self, wheels):
        def download(command):
            self.assertEqual(command[command.index("--platform") + 1], "any")
            self.assertEqual(command[command.index("--abi") + 1], "none")
            destination = Path(command[command.index("--dest") + 1])
            self.assertEqual(list(destination.iterdir()), [])
            for wheel in wheels:
                shutil.copy2(wheel, destination / wheel.name)
        return download

    def test_partial_cache_installs_all_selected_wheels_and_no_obsolete_versions(self):
        wheels = [self.wheel(name) for name in runtime.PURE_PYTHON_MODULES]
        for wheel in wheels[:-1]:
            shutil.copy2(wheel, self.cache / wheel.name)
        obsolete = self.wheel("colorama", version="0.1")
        shutil.copy2(obsolete, self.cache / obsolete.name)
        installed = self.root / "site-packages"
        with patch.object(runtime, "run", side_effect=self.pip_result(wheels)):
            names = runtime.install_pure_python_dependencies(installed, self.cache)
        self.assertEqual(names, sorted(wheel.name for wheel in wheels))
        for module in runtime.PURE_PYTHON_MODULES:
            self.assertTrue((installed / module / "__init__.py").is_file())
        self.assertFalse((installed / "colorama-0.1.dist-info").exists())
        self.assertEqual((installed / "colorama/__init__.py").read_text(), "VERSION = '1.0'\n")

    def test_all_cached_wheels_remain_the_complete_resolution(self):
        wheels = [self.wheel(name) for name in runtime.PURE_PYTHON_MODULES]
        for wheel in wheels:
            shutil.copy2(wheel, self.cache / wheel.name)
        with patch.object(runtime, "run", side_effect=self.pip_result(wheels)):
            selected = runtime.download_wheels(self.cache, runtime.PURE_PYTHON_SPECS)
        self.assertEqual(selected, sorted((self.cache / wheel.name).resolve() for wheel in wheels))

    @unittest.skipUnless(importlib.util.find_spec("pip"), "pip is needed for the offline resolver check")
    def test_real_pip_resolves_complete_wheel_set_offline(self):
        wheels = [self.wheel("colorama"), self.wheel("wcwidth")]
        shutil.copy2(wheels[0], self.cache / wheels[0].name)
        with patch.object(runtime, "run", side_effect=lambda command: subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)):
            selected = runtime.download_wheels(
                self.cache, ("colorama==1.0", "wcwidth==1.0"),
                ["--isolated", "--no-index", "--no-cache-dir", "--find-links", str(self.available)],
            )
        self.assertEqual(selected, sorted((self.cache / wheel.name).resolve() for wheel in wheels))

    def test_native_or_non_pure_wheels_are_rejected_before_caching(self):
        for pure, tag in (("false", "py3-none-any"), ("true", "cp310-cp310-macosx_11_0_arm64")):
            with self.subTest(pure=pure, tag=tag):
                wheel = self.wheel("native", pure=pure, tag=tag)
                with patch.object(runtime, "run", side_effect=self.pip_result([wheel])):
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "仅允许纯 Python any wheel"):
                        runtime.download_wheels(self.cache, ("native",))
                self.assertFalse((self.cache / wheel.name).exists())

    def test_missing_wheel_metadata_is_rejected(self):
        wheel = self.available / "broken-1.0-py3-none-any.whl"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel, "w") as archive:
            archive.writestr("broken/__init__.py", "")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "wheel 元数据不完整"):
            runtime.validate_pure_python_wheel(wheel)

    def test_protected_entry_names_are_rejected_before_metadata_or_payload_reads(self):
        for name in (".env", "package/.env.production", "package/.env.local/data", "package\\.env.test"):
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                archive = MagicMock()
                archive.infolist.return_value = [
                    zipfile.ZipInfo("package/__init__.py"),
                    zipfile.ZipInfo("package-1.0.dist-info/WHEEL"),
                    zipfile.ZipInfo(name),
                ]
                with patch.object(runtime.zipfile, "ZipFile") as opening:
                    opening.return_value.__enter__.return_value = archive
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "受保护的环境文件路径"):
                        runtime.validate_pure_python_wheel(self.root / "fixture.whl")
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "受保护的环境文件路径"):
                        runtime.install_wheel(self.root / "fixture.whl", self.root / "installed")
                archive.read.assert_not_called()
                archive.open.assert_not_called()
                self.assertFalse((self.root / "installed").exists())

    def test_exact_env_example_is_allowed(self):
        wheel = self.wheel("example")
        with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel, "a") as archive:
            archive.writestr("example/.env.example", "EXAMPLE=value\n")
        runtime.validate_pure_python_wheel(wheel)
        runtime.install_wheel(wheel, self.root / "installed")
        self.assertTrue((self.root / "installed/example/.env.example").is_file())

    def test_empty_resolution_does_not_reuse_obsolete_cache(self):
        wheel = self.wheel("obsolete")
        shutil.copy2(wheel, self.cache / wheel.name)
        with patch.object(runtime, "run", side_effect=self.pip_result([])):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(FileNotFoundError, "未下载到纯 Python wheel"):
                runtime.download_wheels(self.cache, ("required",))


class FridaLayoutTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()

            self.assertIn(str(host), ordinary.stdout)
            with self.assertRaises(subprocess.CalledProcessError) as failure:
                self.validate()
        self.assertIn("No module named 'wcwidth'", failure.exception.stderr)

    def test_dependency_symlink_outside_target_is_rejected(self):
        host = Path(self.temporary.name) / "host"
        host.mkdir()
        shutil.move(str(self.site / "wcwidth"), host / "wcwidth")
        (self.site / "wcwidth").symlink_to(host / "wcwidth", target_is_directory=True)
        with self.assertRaises(subprocess.CalledProcessError) as failure:
            self.validate()
        self.assertIn("was imported outside the target", failure.exception.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ios_ish_build.py`:

```py
"""Exercise iSH cache invalidation and rootfs retention without invoking Xcode."""
import argparse
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ish_build_state", ROOT / "tools/ios/ish-build-state.py")
state = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(state)
RUNTIME = "frida_runtime=official-frida-tools-12.1.0-frida-16.0.7-v13"


def git(directory, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(directory), *args], stderr=subprocess.PIPE)


class LibraryCacheTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        ish = self.root / "third_party/ish"
        for path in (ish, ish / "deps/libarchive", ish / "deps/libapps"):
            path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            git(path, "init", "-q")
            (path / "source.c").write_text("original source")
            git(path, "add", "source.c")
            git(path, "-c", "user.name=Fixture", "-c", "user.email=fixture@example.invalid", "commit", "-qm", "fixture")
        scripts = self.root / "tools/ios"
        (scripts / "patches").mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in ("ish-build-state.py", "build-ish-libs.sh", "prepare-ish-source.py", "patches/ish-mira.patch"):
            (scripts / name).write_text("fixture " + name)
        self.args = argparse.Namespace(root=self.root, build_dir=self.root / "output", sdk="iphoneos", configuration="Debug", archs="arm64", extra_ldflags="", action="check")
        self.manifest = self.args.build_dir / "mira-ish-libraries.json"
        products = state.product_directory(self.args)
        products.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in state.LIBRARIES:
            (products / name).write_bytes(b"nonempty archive " + name.encode())
        real_command = state.command
        self.xcode_version = "Xcode fixture"

        def command(*args):
            if args[0] == "xcrun":
                return "sdk-fixture/" + args[2] + "/" + args[3]
            if args[0] == "xcodebuild":
                return self.xcode_version
            return real_command(*args)

        self.command_patch = patch.object(state, "command", side_effect=command)
        self.command_patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.command_patch.stop)
        self.tool_patch = patch.object(state, "tool_identity", return_value={"version": "fixture"})
        self.tool_patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.tool_patch.stop)

    def operation(self, action):
        self.args.action = action
        return state.libraries(self.args)

    def complete_build(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.operation("begin"), 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.operation("finish"), 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.operation("check"), 0)

    def test_old_archives_without_manifest_are_stale(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.operation("check"), 1)
        self.complete_build()

    def test_sdk_architecture_configuration_and_flags_invalidate(self):
        self.complete_build()
        for field, value in (("sdk", "iphonesimulator"), ("archs", "x86_64"), ("configuration", "Release"), ("extra_ldflags", "-lcustom")):
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                previous = getattr(self.args, field)
                setattr(self.args, field, value)
                self.assertEqual(self.operation("check"), 1)
                setattr(self.args, field, previous)
        self.xcode_version = "New Xcode"
        self.assertEqual(self.operation("check"), 1)

    def test_source_dependency_and_patch_edits_invalidate(self):
        self.complete_build()
        for name in ("third_party/ish/source.c", "third_party/ish/deps/libarchive/source.c", "third_party/ish/deps/libapps/source.c", "tools/ios/patches/ish-mira.patch"):
            with self.subTest(path=name):
                path = self.root / name
                original = path.read_bytes()
                path.write_bytes(original + b" modified")
                self.assertEqual(self.operation("check"), 1)
                path.write_bytes(original)
        self.assertEqual(self.operation("check"), 0)

    def test_interrupted_rebuild_cannot_reuse_previous_manifest(self):
        self.complete_build()
        self.operation("begin")
        self.assertFalse(self.manifest.exists())
        (state.product_directory(self.args) / "libish.a").write_bytes(b"partial archive")
        self.assertEqual(self.operation("check"), 1)

    def test_changed_inputs_and_empty_products_refuse_completion(self):
        self.operation("begin")
        self.xcode_version = "changed while building"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "inputs changed"):
            self.operation("finish")
        self.assertFalse(self.manifest.exists())
        self.operation("begin")
        (state.product_directory(self.args) / "libish.a").write_bytes(b"")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "empty"):
            self.operation("finish")
        self.assertFalse(self.manifest.exists())

    def test_modified_archive_is_not_reusable(self):
        self.complete_build()
        (state.product_directory(self.args) / "libish.a").write_bytes(b"different nonempty archive")
        self.assertEqual(self.operation("check"), 1)

    def test_protected_names_and_symlink_targets_are_never_hashed(self):
        directory = self.root / "third_party/ish"
        before = state.source_identity(directory)
        (directory / "alias").symlink_to(".env")
        tracked_names = git(directory, "ls-files", "-z") + b".env\0.env.local\0alias\0"
        real_output = subprocess.check_output

        def listed_output(arguments, **kwargs):
            if arguments[-2:] == ["ls-files", "-z"]:
                return tracked_names
            return real_output(arguments, **kwargs)

        real_hash = state.file_sha256

        def guarded_hash(path):
            self.assertNotIn(path.name, (".env", ".env.local", "alias"))
            return real_hash(path)

        with patch.object(state, "file_sha256", side_effect=guarded_hash), \
                patch.object(state.subprocess, "check_output", side_effect=listed_output):
            self.assertEqual(state.source_identity(directory), before)


class RootfsProvenanceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.directory = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.output = self.directory / "MiraISHRoot.fakefs"
        (self.output / "data").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.output / "data/1").write_bytes(b"retained user-space")
        (self.output / "meta.db").write_bytes(b"filesystem metadata")
        (self.output / ".mira-ish-rootfs.stamp").write_text("rootfs=appstore-apk\n" + RUNTIME + "\npython_version=3.11\n")
        self.args = argparse.Namespace(action="reuse", root=self.directory, output=self.output, url=state.DEFAULT_ROOTFS_URL, runtime_stamp=RUNTIME)

    def test_legacy_rootfs_is_preserved_without_any_source_or_download(self):
        before = (self.output / "data/1").read_bytes()
        with patch.object(state, "command", side_effect=AssertionError("Must not inspect/build iSH to reuse userspace")):
            self.assertEqual(state.rootfs_state(self.args), 0)
            self.args.root = self.directory / "a-different-ish-checkout"
            self.assertEqual(state.rootfs_state(self.args), 0)
        manifest = json.loads((self.output / ".mira-ish-rootfs.provenance.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(manifest["creation"], "adopted-legacy")
        self.assertIsNone(manifest["producer_ish_revision"])
        self.assertEqual((self.output / "data/1").read_bytes(), before)

    def test_changed_runtime_source_or_artifact_is_not_silently_adopted(self):
        self.assertEqual(state.rootfs_state(self.args), 0)
        self.args.runtime_stamp = "frida_runtime=different"
        self.assertEqual(state.rootfs_state(self.args), 1)
        self.args.runtime_stamp = RUNTIME
        self.args.url = "https://example.invalid/different.tar.gz"
        self.assertEqual(state.rootfs_state(self.args), 1)
        self.args.url = state.DEFAULT_ROOTFS_URL
        (self.output / "meta.db").write_bytes(b"changed metadata")
        self.assertEqual(state.rootfs_state(self.args), 1)

    def test_real_prepare_script_reuses_prebuilt_without_build_tools(self):
        environment = dict(os.environ, MIRA_ISH_ROOTFS_OUTPUT=str(self.output), MIRA_ISH_ROOTFS_URL=state.DEFAULT_ROOTFS_URL)
        result = subprocess.run(["bash", str(ROOT / "tools/ios/prepare-ish-rootfs.sh")], env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        self.assertIn("already prepared", result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("Downloading", result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual((self.output / "data/1").read_bytes(), b"retained user-space")

    def make_archive(self, name="etc/version"):
        archive_path = self.directory / "rootfs.tar.gz"
        with tarfile.open(archive_path, "w:gz") as archive:
            member = tarfile.TarInfo(name)
            payload = b"fixture"
            member.size = len(payload)
            archive.addfile(member, io.BytesIO(payload))
        return archive_path

    def test_archive_pin_and_custom_url_provenance(self):
        archive = self.make_archive()
        args = argparse.Namespace(action="verify", archive=archive, url=state.DEFAULT_ROOTFS_URL)
        with patch.object(state, "DEFAULT_ROOTFS_SHA256", state.file_sha256(archive)):
            self.assertEqual(state.archive_state(args), 0)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "pinned baseline"):
            state.archive_state(args)
        args.url = "https://example.invalid/custom.tar.gz"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "provenance"):
            state.archive_state(args)
        args.action = "record"
        self.assertEqual(state.archive_state(args), 0)
        args.action = "verify"
        self.assertEqual(state.archive_state(args), 0)
        args.url = "https://example.invalid/other.tar.gz"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "provenance"):
            state.archive_state(args)

    def test_protected_archive_is_rejected_before_hashing_or_extraction(self):
        archive = self.make_archive("etc/.env.local")
        args = argparse.Namespace(action="record", archive=archive, url=state.DEFAULT_ROOTFS_URL)
        with patch.object(state, "file_sha256", side_effect=AssertionError("Must inspect names before hashing")):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "protected environment"):
                state.archive_state(args)

    def test_symlink_archive_is_rejected_before_tarfile_opens_it(self):
        archive = self.make_archive()
        alias = self.directory / "alias.tar.gz"
        alias.symlink_to(archive.name)
        args = argparse.Namespace(action="record", archive=alias, url=state.DEFAULT_ROOTFS_URL)
        with patch.object(state.tarfile, "open", side_effect=AssertionError("Must reject symlinks before opening")):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "symlinked rootfs archive"):
                state.archive_state(args)

    def test_protected_hardlink_target_is_rejected_before_hashing(self):
        archive = self.directory / "hardlink.tar.gz"
        with tarfile.open(archive, "w:gz") as handle:
            member = tarfile.TarInfo("alias")
            member.type = tarfile.LNKTYPE
            member.linkname = "etc/.env.production"
            handle.addfile(member)
        args = argparse.Namespace(action="record", archive=archive, url=state.DEFAULT_ROOTFS_URL)
        with patch.object(state, "file_sha256", side_effect=AssertionError("Must inspect link targets before hashing")):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "protected environment"):
                state.archive_state(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ios_ish_mmap.py`:

```py
"""Exercise iSH's production mmap address selection with a small host page table."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / "third_party/ish/kernel/mmap.c"


STUBS = r"""
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef uint32_t addr_t, dword_t, page_t, pages_t;
typedef int fd_t;
#define PAGE_BITS 12
#define PAGE_SIZE (1U << PAGE_BITS)
#define PAGE(addr) ((addr) >> PAGE_BITS)
#define PGOFFSET(addr) ((addr) & (PAGE_SIZE - 1))
#define PAGE_ROUND_UP(bytes) PAGE((bytes) + PAGE_SIZE - 1)
#define BAD_PAGE 0x10000
#define MMAP_SHARED 0x1
#define MMAP_PRIVATE 0x2
#define MMAP_FIXED 0x10
#define MMAP_ANONYMOUS 0x20
#define P_SHARED (1 << 7)
#define _EINVAL (-22)
#define _ENOMEM (-12)
#define _EBADF (-9)
#define _ENODEV (-19)
#define PAGE_COUNT 16

struct fd;
struct data { struct fd *fd; dword_t file_offset; unsigned char marker; };
struct pt_entry { struct data *data; };
struct mem {
    bool mapped[PAGE_COUNT];
    struct data data[PAGE_COUNT];
    struct pt_entry entries[PAGE_COUNT];
};
struct fd_ops {
    int (*mmap)(struct fd *, struct mem *, page_t, pages_t,
                dword_t, dword_t, dword_t);
};
struct fd { const struct fd_ops *ops; };
static struct mem memory;
static struct task { struct mem *mem; } task = { &memory };
static struct task *current = &task;

static bool pt_is_hole(struct mem *mem, page_t first, pages_t count) {
    if (first >= PAGE_COUNT || count > PAGE_COUNT - first) return false;
    for (page_t page = first; page < first + count; page++)
        if (mem->mapped[page]) return false;
    return true;
}

static page_t pt_find_hole(struct mem *mem, pages_t count) {
    for (page_t page = PAGE_COUNT - 1; page > 0; page--)
        if (pt_is_hole(mem, page, count)) return page;
    return BAD_PAGE;
}

// Like kernel/memory.c, mapping replaces an existing page and its contents.
static int pt_map_nothing(struct mem *mem, page_t first, pages_t count,
                          unsigned flags) {
    (void)flags;
    if (first >= PAGE_COUNT || count > PAGE_COUNT - first) return _ENOMEM;
    for (page_t page = first; page < first + count; page++) {
        mem->mapped[page] = true;
        mem->data[page] = (struct data) {0};
        mem->entries[page].data = &mem->data[page];
    }
    return 0;
}

// These tests exercise anonymous mappings; file mappings remain unsupported.
static struct fd *f_get(fd_t fd) { (void)fd; return NULL; }
static struct fd *fd_retain(struct fd *fd) { return fd; }
static struct pt_entry *mem_pt(struct mem *mem, page_t page) {
    return &mem->entries[page];
}
"""


CASES = r"""
#define REQUIRE(condition, message) do { \
    if (!(condition)) { fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", message); return 1; } \
} while (0)

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    REQUIRE(argc == 2, "one scenario is required");
    const addr_t hint = 4 * PAGE_SIZE;
    const dword_t flags = MMAP_PRIVATE | MMAP_ANONYMOUS;
    const dword_t prot = 3;
    addr_t result;

    if (!strcmp(argv[1], "hint_collision")) {
        pt_map_nothing(&memory, PAGE(hint), 1, prot);
        memory.data[PAGE(hint)].marker = 0x5a;
        result = do_mmap(hint, PAGE_SIZE, prot, flags, -1, 0);
        REQUIRE(result != hint, "occupied non-fixed hint replaced the old mapping");
        REQUIRE(PAGE(result) < PAGE_COUNT && memory.mapped[PAGE(result)],
                "occupied non-fixed hint did not allocate a new mapping");
        REQUIRE(memory.mapped[PAGE(hint)] && memory.data[PAGE(hint)].marker == 0x5a,
                "occupied non-fixed hint lost the original contents");
    } else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "fixed_replacement")) {
        pt_map_nothing(&memory, PAGE(hint), 1, prot);
        memory.data[PAGE(hint)].marker = 0x5a;
        result = do_mmap(hint, PAGE_SIZE, prot, flags | MMAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
        REQUIRE(result == hint && memory.mapped[PAGE(hint)],
                "MAP_FIXED did not replace the requested mapping");
        REQUIRE(memory.data[PAGE(hint)].marker == 0,
                "MAP_FIXED anonymous replacement kept the old contents");
    } else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "null_hint")) {
        result = do_mmap(0, PAGE_SIZE, prot, flags, -1, 0);
        REQUIRE(result != 0 && PAGE(result) < PAGE_COUNT,
                "null hint did not select a valid hole");
        REQUIRE(memory.mapped[PAGE(result)], "null hint did not map the hole");
    } else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "no_space")) {
        pt_map_nothing(&memory, 0, PAGE_COUNT, prot);
        for (page_t page = 0; page < PAGE_COUNT; page++)
            memory.data[page].marker = 0x5a;
        REQUIRE(do_mmap(0, PAGE_SIZE, prot, flags, -1, 0) == (addr_t)_ENOMEM,
                "null hint with no free space did not return ENOMEM");
        REQUIRE(do_mmap(hint, PAGE_SIZE, prot, flags, -1, 0) == (addr_t)_ENOMEM,
                "occupied hint with no free space did not return ENOMEM");
        for (page_t page = 0; page < PAGE_COUNT; page++)
            REQUIRE(memory.mapped[page] && memory.data[page].marker == 0x5a,
                    "failed allocation changed an existing mapping");
    } else {
        REQUIRE(false, "unknown scenario");
    }
    printf("PASS: %s\n", argv[1]);
    return 0;
}
"""


class IshMmapTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        compiler = shutil.which("clang") or shutil.which("cc")
        if compiler is None:
            raise RuntimeError("A host C compiler is required for the iSH mmap regression")
        source = SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        start = source.index("static addr_t do_mmap(")
        end = source.index("\n}\n", start) + len("\n}\n")
        cls.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="mira-ish-mmap-test-")
        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.temporary.cleanup)
        directory = Path(cls.temporary.name)
        harness = directory / "mmap_test.c"
        cls.executable = directory / "mmap_test"
        harness.write_text(STUBS + source[start:end] + CASES, encoding="utf-8")
        result = subprocess.run(
            [compiler, "-std=c11", "-Wall", "-Wextra", str(harness),
             "-o", str(cls.executable)],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30,
        )
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f"iSH mmap harness did not compile:\n{result.stderr}")

    def run_case(self, scenario):
        result = subprocess.run(
            [str(self.executable), scenario],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5,
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(f"PASS: {scenario}", result.stdout)

    def test_occupied_hint_preserves_existing_mapping(self):
        self.run_case("hint_collision")

    def test_map_fixed_replaces_existing_mapping(self):
        self.run_case("fixed_replacement")

    def test_null_hint_allocates_a_hole(self):
        self.run_case("null_hint")

    def test_no_space_returns_enomem_without_changing_mappings(self):
        self.run_case("no_space")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ios_ish_source.py`:

```py
"""Apply the shipped iSH patch in isolated Git repositories, never in the submodule."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PATCH = ROOT / "tools/ios/patches/ish-mira.patch"
FILES = ("kernel/mmap.c", "app/xcode-meson.sh", "app/xcode-ninja.sh", "fs/tty.c")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("prepare_ish_source", ROOT / "tools/ios/prepare-ish-source.py")
prepare_source = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(prepare_source)


def git(directory, *arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", str(directory), "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", *arguments],
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    )


class IOSISHSourceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        # Read only the four named source blobs from the reviewed upstream commit.
        cls.upstream = {
            name: git(ROOT / "third_party/ish", "show", f"{prepare_source.ISH_REVISION}:{name}")
            for name in FILES
        }

    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.source = Path(temporary.name)
        git(self.source, "init", "--quiet", "--template=")
        for name, content in self.upstream.items():
            path = self.source / name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(content)
        (self.source / "notes.txt").write_text("original notes\n")
        git(self.source, "add", *FILES, "notes.txt")
        git(
            self.source, "-c", "user.name=Mira Test", "-c",
            "user.email=mira-test@example.invalid", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false",
            "commit", "--quiet", "-m", "fixture",
        )
        self.revision = git(self.source, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()

    def prepare(self, revision=None):
        prepare_source.prepare(self.source, PATCH, self.revision if revision is None else revision)

    def snapshot(self):
        return (
            {name: (self.source / name).read_bytes() for name in (*FILES, "notes.txt")},
            git(self.source, "diff", "--binary"),
            git(self.source, "diff", "--cached", "--binary"),
            git(self.source, "status", "--porcelain"),
        )

    def test_shipped_patch_applies_completely_and_repeating_is_a_noop(self):
        self.prepare()
        changed = set(git(self.source, "diff", "--name-only").decode().splitlines())
        self.assertEqual(changed, set(FILES))
        git(self.source, "apply", "--reverse", "--check", str(PATCH))
        self.assertEqual(git(self.source, "diff", "--cached"), b"")
        applied = self.snapshot()
        self.prepare()
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), applied)

    def test_revision_mismatch_refuses_before_modifying_any_files(self):
        before = self.snapshot()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "no reviewed Mira patch"):
            self.prepare(revision="0" * 40)
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)
        # The revision guard also runs when the working tree is already patched.
        self.prepare()
        applied = self.snapshot()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "no reviewed Mira patch"):
            self.prepare(revision="0" * 40)
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), applied)

    def test_conflict_preserves_local_edits_and_other_patch_targets(self):
        path = self.source / "kernel/mmap.c"
        original = path.read_bytes()
        self.assertIn(b"    page_t page;\n", original)
        path.write_bytes(original.replace(b"    page_t page;\n", b"    page_t local_page;\n", 1))
        before = self.snapshot()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "conflicts with local changes"):
            self.prepare()
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)
        for name in FILES[1:]:
            self.assertEqual((self.source / name).read_bytes(), self.upstream[name])

    def test_unrelated_working_index_and_untracked_changes_survive(self):
        local_suffix = b"\n/* Local research note outside the compatibility patch. */\n"
        mmap = self.source / "kernel/mmap.c"
        mmap.write_bytes(mmap.read_bytes() + local_suffix)
        (self.source / "notes.txt").write_text("user notes staged before preparation\n")
        git(self.source, "add", "notes.txt")
        scratch = self.source / "scratch.txt"
        scratch.write_bytes(b"untracked user work\n")
        index_before = git(self.source, "diff", "--cached", "--binary")
        self.prepare()
        self.assertTrue(mmap.read_bytes().endswith(local_suffix))
        self.assertEqual((self.source / "notes.txt").read_text(), "user notes staged before preparation\n")
        self.assertEqual(scratch.read_bytes(), b"untracked user work\n")
        self.assertEqual(git(self.source, "diff", "--cached", "--binary"), index_before)
        applied = self.snapshot()
        self.prepare()
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), applied)
        self.assertEqual(scratch.read_bytes(), b"untracked user work\n")

    def test_partial_prior_patch_refuses_without_applying_remaining_hunks(self):
        git(self.source, "apply", "--include=kernel/mmap.c", str(PATCH))
        before = self.snapshot()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "conflicts with local changes"):
            self.prepare()
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ios_ish_tty.py`:

```py
"""Exercise production iSH TTY input/read with real host condition variables."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / "third_party/ish/fs/tty.c"
HEADER = ROOT / "third_party/ish/fs/tty.h"


PREAMBLE = r"""
#include <assert.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/types.h>

typedef uint32_t dword_t;
typedef uint8_t byte_t;
typedef uint16_t word_t;
typedef int pid_t_;
typedef uint64_t sigset_t_;
typedef pthread_mutex_t lock_t;
typedef pthread_cond_t cond_t;
"""


STUBS = r"""
#define _EAGAIN (-11)
#define _EINTR (-4)
#define _EIO (-5)
#define _ETIMEDOUT (-110)
#define POLL_READ 1
#define SIGINT_ 2
#define SIGQUIT_ 3
#define SIGTSTP_ 20
#define SIGTTIN_ 21
#define NUM_SIGS 64
#define SIGINFO_NIL NULL
#define O_NONBLOCK_ 04000

struct tty;
struct tty_driver_ops {
    int (*write)(struct tty *, const void *, size_t, bool);
};
struct tty_driver { const struct tty_driver_ops *ops; };
struct tty {
    struct tty_driver *driver;
    char buf[TTY_BUF_SIZE];
    bool buf_flag[TTY_BUF_SIZE];
    size_t bufsize;
    cond_t produced, consumed;
    lock_t lock;
    struct termios_ termios;
    pid_t_ fg_group;
    bool hung_up;
    uint8_t packet_flags;
    struct { bool packet_mode; } pty;
};
struct fd { struct tty *tty; int flags; };
static struct tty_driver driver, pty_master;
static struct tty terminal = {
    .driver = &driver,
    .lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER,
    .produced = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER,
    .consumed = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER,
};
static lock_t pids_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static struct group { pid_t_ pgid; } group;
static struct task { struct group *group; } task = { &group };
static struct task *current = &task;
static pthread_mutex_t ready_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t ready_cond = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static bool reader_waiting;

static void lock(lock_t *mutex) { assert(!pthread_mutex_lock(mutex)); }
static void unlock(lock_t *mutex) { assert(!pthread_mutex_unlock(mutex)); }
static void notify(cond_t *cond) { assert(!pthread_cond_broadcast(cond)); }
static int wait_for(cond_t *cond, lock_t *mutex, struct timespec *timeout) {
    assert(timeout == NULL); // These cases use VMIN=1, VTIME=0.
    if (cond == &terminal.produced) {
        lock(&ready_lock);
        reader_waiting = true;
        notify(&ready_cond);
        unlock(&ready_lock);
    }
    // Matches util/sync.c's wait without guest task signal delivery.
    assert(!pthread_cond_wait(cond, mutex));
    return 0;
}

// Job control, poll subscribers, and driver echo are outside these raw-mode cases.
static void tty_poll_wakeup(struct tty *tty, int events) { (void)tty; (void)events; }
static bool pty_is_half_closed_master(struct tty *tty) { (void)tty; return false; }
static int tty_signal_if_background(struct tty *tty, pid_t_ pgid, int sig) {
    (void)tty; (void)pgid; (void)sig; return 0;
}
static void sigset_add(sigset_t_ *set, int sig) { *set |= UINT64_C(1) << sig; }
static bool sigset_has(sigset_t_ set, int sig) { return set & (UINT64_C(1) << sig); }
static void send_group_signal(pid_t_ pgid, int sig, const void *info) {
    (void)pgid; (void)sig; (void)info;
}
"""


CASES = r"""
#define REQUIRE(condition, message) do { \
    if (!(condition)) { fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", message); return 1; } \
} while (0)

static char input[TTY_BUF_SIZE * 2 + 1], output[sizeof(input)];
static size_t input_size, received;
static struct fd fd = { .tty = &terminal };

static void *reader(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
    while (received < input_size) {
        size_t amount = input_size - received;
        if (amount > 997) amount = 997;
        ssize_t count = tty_read(&fd, output + received, amount);
        if (count <= 0) return (void *)1;
        received += count;
    }
    return NULL;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    REQUIRE(argc == 2, "one scenario is required");
    terminal.termios.cc[VMIN_] = 1;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(input); i++)
        input[i] = (char)('a' + i % 26);

    if (!strcmp(argv[1], "nonblocking")) {
        ssize_t written = tty_input(&terminal, input, sizeof(input), false);
        REQUIRE(written == TTY_BUF_SIZE, "nonblocking input did not return its partial count");
        REQUIRE(tty_input(&terminal, input + written, 1, false) == _EAGAIN,
                "full nonblocking input did not return EAGAIN");
        REQUIRE(tty_read(&fd, output, sizeof(output)) == written,
                "nonblocking input could not be read back");
        REQUIRE(!memcmp(input, output, written), "nonblocking input changed bytes");
    } else {
        if (!strcmp(argv[1], "capacity")) input_size = TTY_BUF_SIZE;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "eight_kib")) input_size = TTY_BUF_SIZE * 2;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "eight_kib_plus_one")) input_size = sizeof(input);
        else REQUIRE(false, "unknown scenario");

        pthread_t thread;
        REQUIRE(!pthread_create(&thread, NULL, reader, NULL), "reader thread creation failed");
        lock(&ready_lock);
        while (!reader_waiting)
            assert(!pthread_cond_wait(&ready_cond, &ready_lock));
        unlock(&ready_lock);
        // The reader still holds terminal.lock until its produced wait begins;
        // this write cannot race ahead of that wait.
        REQUIRE(tty_input(&terminal, input, input_size, true) == (ssize_t)input_size,
                "blocking input returned before accepting every byte");
        void *reader_error;
        REQUIRE(!pthread_join(thread, &reader_error) && reader_error == NULL,
                "reader failed");
        REQUIRE(received == input_size, "reader did not receive every byte");
        REQUIRE(!memcmp(input, output, input_size), "input was reordered, lost, or duplicated");
    }
    REQUIRE(terminal.bufsize == 0, "read left unexpected bytes in the TTY");
    printf("PASS: %s\n", argv[1]);
    return 0;
}
"""


def function(source, signature):
    start = source.index(signature)
    return source[start:source.index("\n}\n", start) + len("\n}\n")]


class IshTtyTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        compiler = shutil.which("clang") or shutil.which("cc")
        if compiler is None:
            raise RuntimeError("A host C compiler is required for the iSH TTY regression")
        source = SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        header = HEADER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        termios = header[header.index("struct termios_ {"):header.index("struct tty_driver {")]
        buffer_size = next(line for line in header.splitlines() if line.startswith("#define TTY_BUF_SIZE "))
        functions = "\n".join(function(source, signature) for signature in (
            "static void tty_input_wakeup(",
            "static int tty_push_char(",
            "static void tty_echo(",
            "static bool tty_send_input_signal(",
            "ssize_t tty_input(",
            "static void tty_read_into_buf(",
            "static size_t tty_canon_size(",
            "static ssize_t tty_read(",
        ))
        cls.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="mira-ish-tty-test-")
        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.temporary.cleanup)
        directory = Path(cls.temporary.name)
        harness = directory / "tty_test.c"
        cls.executable = directory / "tty_test"
        harness.write_text(
            PREAMBLE + termios + buffer_size + "\n" + STUBS + functions + CASES,
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        result = subprocess.run(
            [compiler, "-std=c11", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-pthread", str(harness),
             "-o", str(cls.executable)],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30,
        )
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f"iSH TTY harness did not compile:\n{result.stderr}")

    def run_case(self, scenario):
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [str(self.executable), scenario],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5,
            )
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"{scenario}: TTY input/read did not complete within 5 seconds"
            ) from error
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(f"PASS: {scenario}", result.stdout)

    def test_one_buffer_wakes_a_waiting_reader(self):
        self.run_case("capacity")

    def test_eight_kib_reaches_a_waiting_reader(self):
        self.run_case("eight_kib")

    def test_more_than_two_buffers_reaches_a_waiting_reader(self):
        self.run_case("eight_kib_plus_one")

    def test_nonblocking_input_reports_partial_write_and_eagain(self):
        self.run_case("nonblocking")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_mcp_stability.py`:

```py
import base64
import contextlib
import io
import os
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import types
import unittest
import zlib
import socket
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from mira.mcp.server import MAX_BUFFER_BYTES, MiraMcpServer, TerminalSession, ToolError
from mira.mcp import frida_agent
from mira.mcp.frida_agent import PersistentAgent


class FridaRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_jsonable_preserves_json_and_binary_bytes(self):
        value = {
            'scalar': 7,
            'text': '你好🙂',
            'array': [True, None, {'nested': 'value'}],
            'binary': memoryview(b'\xe4\xbd\xa0\x00\xf0\x9f\x99\x82'),
            'empty': bytearray(),
        }
        self.assertEqual(frida_agent.jsonable(value), {
            'scalar': 7,
            'text': '你好🙂',
            'array': [True, None, {'nested': 'value'}],
            'binary': {
                'type': 'bytes', 'encoding': 'base64',
                'dataBase64': base64.b64encode(b'\xe4\xbd\xa0\x00\xf0\x9f\x99\x82').decode(),
            },
            'empty': {'type': 'bytes', 'encoding': 'base64', 'dataBase64': ''},
        })

    def test_jsonable_rejects_lossy_values_and_cycles(self):
        cyclic = []
        cyclic.append(cyclic)
        cases = [object(), float('nan'), float('inf'), cyclic, {1: 'not a JSON key'}]
        for value in cases:
            with self.subTest(value=type(value).__name__), self.assertRaisesRegex(
                    TypeError, 'not JSON-compatible'):
                frida_agent.jsonable(value)

    def source(self, **extra):
        return MiraMcpServer.build_frida_python_source(dict(mode='run_script',
            scriptBase64=base64.b64encode(b'rpc.exports = {};').decode(), rpcMethod='ping',
            waitSeconds=0, operationTimeout=2, **extra))

    def run_fake(self, legacy=False, fail=False):
        calls = []
        exports = types.SimpleNamespace(ping=lambda: 'pong')
        class Script:
            def on(self, *args): pass
            def load(self):
                if fail: raise RuntimeError('load failed')
            def unload(self): calls.append('unload')
        script = Script()
        setattr(script, 'exports' if legacy else 'exports_sync', exports)
        session = types.SimpleNamespace(create_script=lambda _: script, detach=lambda: calls.append('detach'))
        device = types.SimpleNamespace(attach=lambda _: session)
        frida = types.SimpleNamespace(get_device_manager=lambda: types.SimpleNamespace(add_remote_device=lambda _: device))
        output = io.StringIO()
        with patch.dict(sys.modules, frida=frida), contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit): exec(self.source(), {})
        return json.loads(output.getvalue()), calls

    def test_legacy_and_current_rpc(self):
        for legacy in (True, False):
            result, calls = self.run_fake(legacy=legacy)
            self.assertEqual(result['rpcResult'], 'pong')
            self.assertEqual(calls, ['unload', 'detach'])

    def test_load_failure_reports_phase_and_cleans_up(self):
        result, calls = self.run_fake(fail=True)
        self.assertFalse(result['ok'])
        self.assertEqual(result['phase'], 'load')
        self.assertIn('traceback', result)
        self.assertEqual(calls, ['unload', 'detach'])

    def test_hung_native_call_has_process_deadline(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            Path(directory, 'frida.py').write_text('''import time
class Device:
 def attach(self, target): time.sleep(60)
class Manager:
 def add_remote_device(self, host): return Device()
def get_device_manager(): return Manager()
''')
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', self.source()], cwd=directory,
                text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=5)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 124)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout)['phase'], 'attach')

    def test_deadline_survives_blocked_or_closed_stdout(self):
        for blocked in (True, False):
            with self.subTest(blocked=blocked), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                Path(directory, 'frida.py').write_text("import os,time\n"
                    "class Device:\n def attach(self, target):\n"
                    + ("  os.write(1, b'x' * 1048576)\n" if blocked else "")
                    + "  time.sleep(60)\nclass Manager:\n def add_remote_device(self, host): return Device()\n"
                    "def get_device_manager(): return Manager()\n")
                child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', self.source()], cwd=directory,
                                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
                try:
                    if not blocked:
                        child.stdout.close()
                    self.assertEqual(child.wait(timeout=5), 124)
                finally:
                    if child.poll() is None:
                        child.kill(); child.wait()
                    child.stdout.close(); child.stderr.close()

    def test_watchdog_restores_inherited_stdout_flags(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            Path(directory, 'frida.py').write_text("import time\n"
                "class Device:\n def attach(self, target): time.sleep(60)\n"
                "class Manager:\n def add_remote_device(self, host): return Device()\n"
                "def get_device_manager(): return Manager()\n")
            read_fd, write_fd = os.pipe()
            child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', self.source()], cwd=directory, stdout=write_fd)
            try:
                self.assertEqual(child.wait(timeout=5), 124)
                self.assertTrue(os.get_blocking(write_fd), 'watchdog changed the parent shell stdout flags')
            finally:
                if child.poll() is None: child.kill(); child.wait()
                os.close(read_fd); os.close(write_fd)

    def test_persistent_command_is_short_single_line_and_round_trips_spec(self):
        spec = {
            'persistentId': 'auto-test', 'script': 'Java.performNow(function () {});' * 100,
            'rpcMethod': 'probe', 'rpcArgs': ['value'], 'cleanupMethod': 'cleanup',
            'operationTimeout': 10,
        }
        command = MiraMcpServer.build_persistent_frida_command(spec)
        self.assertNotIn('\n', command)
        self.assertLess(len(command), 1500)
        encoded = __import__('shlex').split(command)[4]
        decoded = json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(encoded)))
        self.assertEqual(decoded, spec)

    def test_runner_reuses_one_script_for_different_sources(self):
        class Exports:
            def execute(self, source, method, args, cleanup):
                return {'ok': True, 'rpcResult': [source, method, args, cleanup],
                        'error': None, 'cleanupError': None}
        class Script:
            exports_sync = Exports()
            def on(self, _, callback): self.callback = callback
            def load(self): pass
        created = []
        runner_sources = []
        agent = PersistentAgent.__new__(PersistentAgent)
        def create_script(source):
            runner_sources.append(source)
            created.append(Script())
            return created[-1]
        agent.session = types.SimpleNamespace(create_script=create_script)
        agent.runner = None
        first = agent.handle({'script': 'first', 'rpcMethod': 'probe',
                              'rpcArgs': [1], 'cleanupMethod': 'cleanup'})
        second = agent.handle({'script': 'second', 'rpcMethod': 'probe',
                               'rpcArgs': [2], 'cleanupMethod': 'cleanup'})
        self.assertEqual(len(created), 1)
        self.assertIn("new Function('rpc', source)(userRpc)", runner_sources[0])
        self.assertIn('miraNormalizeRpcValue', runner_sources[0])
        self.assertIn('value.byteOffset, value.byteLength', runner_sources[0])
        self.assertIn("encoding: 'base64'", runner_sources[0])
        self.assertIn('Object.defineProperty(objectResult, key', runner_sources[0])
        self.assertNotIn('eval(source)', runner_sources[0])
        self.assertFalse(first['reusedScript'])
        self.assertTrue(second['reusedScript'])
        self.assertEqual(second['rpcResult'][0], 'second')

    def test_persistent_client_timeout_after_send_is_not_replayed(self):
        encoded = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(zlib.compress(b'{}')).decode()
        with patch.object(frida_agent, 'exchange', side_effect=socket.timeout('late')) as exchange_mock, \
             patch.object(frida_agent.subprocess, 'Popen') as popen_mock, \
             contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as output, self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            frida_agent.run_client('/tmp/test-agent.sock', encoded, 0.01)
        self.assertEqual(exchange_mock.call_count, 1)
        popen_mock.assert_not_called()
        self.assertIn('outcome unknown; not retried', output.getvalue())

    def test_persistent_daemon_survives_broken_client_response(self):
        class Connection:
            chunks = [b'{}', b'']
            def recv(self, _): return self.chunks.pop(0)
            def sendall(self, _): raise BrokenPipeError('client closed')
        agent = types.SimpleNamespace(handle=lambda request: {'ok': True, 'request': request})
        frida_agent.serve_connection(agent, Connection())

    def test_mcp_dispatch_rejects_concurrent_frida_operation_without_running_it(self):
        server = MiraMcpServer('http://relay', '')
        server.frida_operation_lock.acquire()
        try:
            with patch.object(server, 'tool_frida_run_script') as run_script:
                server.tools['mira_frida_run_script'] = run_script
                result = server.call_tool({'name': 'mira_frida_run_script', 'arguments': {}})
        finally:
            server.frida_operation_lock.release()
        run_script.assert_not_called()
        self.assertTrue(result['isError'])
        self.assertIn('another Frida operation is active', str(result))


class TerminalRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_session(self):
        return TerminalSession('session', 'device', None, None, status='active')

    def test_disconnect_returns_immediately(self):
        session = self.make_session()
        session._set_status('device disconnected')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ToolError, 'session ended'):
            session.wait_for_text('missing', 60)

    def test_multibyte_history_and_ring_rollover(self):
        for history in ('中文'.encode(), b'x' * MAX_BUFFER_BYTES):
            session = self.make_session()
            session._append_output(history)
            def send(command):
                marker = re.search(r'__MIRA_MCP_DONE_[a-f0-9]+__', command).group()
                session._append_output(('结果\n' + marker + ':0\n').encode())
            session.send_input = send
            result = MiraMcpServer('http://localhost', '').execute_command(session, 'echo result', 1)
            self.assertEqual(result['exitCode'], 0)
            self.assertIn('结果', result['output'])

    def test_pty_repeated_carriage_returns(self):
        block = MiraMcpServer.extract_marked_block('prompt\r\r\nBEGIN\r\r\n{"ok":true}\r\r\nEND\r\r\n', 'BEGIN', 'END', 'test')
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(block), {'ok': True})

    def test_timeout_prevents_command_overlap(self):
        session = self.make_session()
        session.send_input = lambda _: None
        session.wait_for_text = lambda *_: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ToolError('timeout'))
        server = MiraMcpServer('http://localhost', '')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ToolError, 'timeout'):
            server.execute_command(session, 'sleep 60', 1)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ToolError, 'previous command'):
            server.execute_command(session, 'echo next', 1)


if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_release.py`:

```py
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile

import pytest

from mira.release import ReleaseError, validate_archive_root


def write_archive(path: Path, names: list[str]) -> None:
    with ZipFile(path, "w") as archive:
        for name in names:
            archive.writestr(name, b"test")


def test_validate_archive_root_accepts_expected_tree(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    archive_path = tmp_path / "Mira-unsigned.ipa"
    write_archive(archive_path, ["Payload/Mira.app/Info.plist", "Payload/Mira.app/Mira"])

    validate_archive_root(archive_path, "Payload")


def test_validate_archive_root_rejects_flat_ipa(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    archive_path = tmp_path / "Mira-unsigned.ipa"
    write_archive(archive_path, ["Mira.app/Info.plist", "Mira.app/Mira"])

    with pytest.raises(ReleaseError, match="预期 Payload/"):
        validate_archive_root(archive_path, "Payload")
```

```py
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class RuntimeExtractionTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_failure_recovery_and_verified_writes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            classes = Path(temporary) / "classes"
            classes.mkdir()
            subprocess.run([
                "javac", "--release", "8", "-d", str(classes),
                str(ROOT / "android/app/src/main/java/com/vwww/mira/runtime/VerifiedExtraction.java"),

            result = subprocess.run([
                "java", "-cp", str(classes), "com.vwww.mira.runtime.VerifiedExtractionTest",

    def test_install_state_failure_and_recovery(self):

        stubs = {
            "android/content/Context.java": "package android.content; import java.io.File; import android.content.res.AssetManager; public abstract class Context { public abstract Context getApplicationContext(); public abstract AssetManager getAssets(); public abstract File getFilesDir(); public abstract File getCacheDir(); public abstract String getPackageCodePath(); }",

            "android/os/Build.java": "package android.os; public class Build { public static String[] SUPPORTED_ABIS = {\"arm64-v8a\"}; }",
            "android/os/SystemClock.java": "package android.os; public class SystemClock { public static long elapsedRealtime() { return 0; } }",
            "android/util/Log.java": "package android.util; public class Log { public static int i(String t, String m) { return 0; } public static int w(String t, String m, Throwable e) { return 0; } }",

                str(ROOT / "tests/java/com/vwww/mira/runtime/RuntimeInstallTest.java")],
                check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
```
